inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Observed 2 dead roaches that were accessible to children near the children restrooms. NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection by removing the insects and disposing of them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: There was not at least 6 inches of loose-fill on the playground under the playground structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: When the inspector asked the caregiver the youngest child's age, the caregiver stated, "The youngest child is 12 months old." The youngest child in the classroom is 18 months old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: There was not at least 6 inches of loose-fill on the playground under the playground structure.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Observed 3 electrical outlets not covered in the toddlers classroom with children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Observed several brown ceiling tiles throughout the operation.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: Two out of three of the vans observed did not have a safety alarm system that worked properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: I observed two out of six children files without an emergency contact address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: I observed chipped paint on the walls in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: I observed the playground fence with sharp nails protruding through.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: Two out of three vans had seatbelts that did not work properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: I observed cleaning products that were accessible to children in the children's restroom.  NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection by being removed out of the reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: Two out of three vans observed did not have a first aid kit on the van. One out of three vans observed first aid kit was missing scissors, tweezers and gloves.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: I observed several trash cans without tops on them throughtout the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: I observed a broken ride on toy and chair on the playground. NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection with the toy and chair being removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: I observed 2 classrooms with children under the age of 5 that did not have electrical outlet.  NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection with covers placed into the outlets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: I observed several classrooms with chipped paint on the walls and  brown ceiling tiles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: I observed the outside fence with 3 broken plywoods and sharp edges protruding out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: 3 dead roaches was on the floor in the cafeteria area where the kids sit and eat meals.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Bottles of cleaning supplies was accessible to children in the cafeteria area. This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: An employee in the infant room did not was their hands after changing an infants diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the information obtained there is sufficient evidence to support that a caregiver used prohibited punishment on a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: A glass cleaner bottle was on the floor and accessible to children in the lunch room. This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Electric outlets in 2 classrooms with children younger than 5 was not covered with childproof covers. This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: There was no number chart available to match the numbers on the cots in several of the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers-911: The required emergency telephone numbers was not available on the required posting board. This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers-911 (26 TAC §746.405(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: 6 children did not have the special needs section acknowledged.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: A caregiver in the infant classroom did not know how many children she had in care. The caregiver stated there were 7 children, but there were 6 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The safety alarm for the transportation van does not work.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Several cots that children were sleeping on in the toddler room were not labeled. One cot had a name on it, but it was not coordinated with the child sleeping on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 2 children's records did not have a health statement from a doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: 1 child in the infant classroom's bottle was not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: In the toddler room there was a bottle of bleach disinfectant cleaner on top of the cubby accessible to children. Note: This was discussed with the director and caregiver and removed immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver was recording a fight between two children ages 6 and 7 without intervening to stop the fight. The caregiver admitted to the Director and parent that she was recording on another child's cell phone and 3 children interviewed also stated the caregiver was recording while the children were fighting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
